subject: science
concept: Understanding circular motion and centripetal force
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student swings a physical object on a string in a circle and feels the inward tension force
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a circular motion scenario to the direction of its centripetal force

misconception_flags: believes there is an outward 'centrifugal force' pulling the object away rather than an inward centripetal force
